nodes.name: Sklearn LDA Variational Bound Helpers
nodes.description: Deterministic LatentDirichletAllocation variational-bound helpers from supplied Dirichlet expectations and variational parameters.

nodes.name: lda_dirichlet_loglikelihood
nodes.description: Compute one scalar Dirichlet prior-minus-variational log-likelihood term used inside the LDA variational bound.
nodes.type_signature: (prior: float, distr: NDArray[np.float64], dirichlet_distr: NDArray[np.float64], size: int) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Dimensionality reduction or sparse coding decomposes high-dimensional features, taking quadratic time in features and linear in samples.

nodes.name: lda_document_log_probability_bound
nodes.description: Compute the scalar E[log p(docs | theta, beta)] contribution in sklearn's LDA bound from supplied document-topic and topic-word expectations.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], dirichlet_doc_topic: NDArray[np.float64], dirichlet_component: NDArray[np.float64]) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Dimensionality reduction or sparse coding decomposes high-dimensional features, taking quadratic time in features and linear in samples.

nodes.name: lda_apply_subsampling_ratio
nodes.description: Apply sklearn's optional document subsampling ratio to a variational bound term.
nodes.type_signature: (score: float, total_samples: float, current_samples: int, sub_sampling: bool = False) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Dimensionality reduction or sparse coding decomposes high-dimensional features, taking quadratic time in features and linear in samples.

nodes.name: lda_approx_bound_from_expectations
nodes.description: Compute sklearn's scalar approximate LDA variational bound from supplied document counts, positive variational parameters, and Dirichlet expectations.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], doc_topic_distr: NDArray[np.float64], dirichlet_doc_topic: NDArray[np.float64], components: NDArray[np.float64], dirichlet_component: NDArray[np.float64], doc_topic_prior: float, topic_word_prior: float, total_samples: float = 1.0, sub_sampling: bool = False) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Dimensionality reduction or sparse coding decomposes high-dimensional features, taking quadratic time in features and linear in samples.
